take: Dallas announced it placed forward Matt Duchene on long-term injured reserve, retroactive to Sept. 29, and recalled forwards Arttu Hyry and Colin Blackwell from Texas (AHL). Hyry, who kills penalties on the third line, has three goals this season, about 1.2 more than his chances would predict, and Dallas controls more of the chance quality when he plays at even strength. Blackwell has gone without a point and the team has done worse with him on the ice. Going by how the coach has used his players, Oskar Bäck is next in line for Duchene's minutes.
